headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.
The reading fell short of a projection of 3.98 per cent from economists polled by financial data provider Wind. On a...

headlines.summary_zh:

国家统计局发布的数据显示，7月工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）同比上涨3.5%，低于6月的4.1%

headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title: 内蒙古自治区首笔“再贴现+汇率避险”业务成功落地
headlines.summary: 【内蒙古自治区首笔“再贴现+汇率避险”业务成功落地】据中国人民银行内蒙古自治区分行消息，近日，在人民银行内蒙古自治区分行指导推动下，全区首笔“再贴现+汇率避险”业务在中国（内蒙古）自由贸易试验区二连浩特片区成功落地。加之6月26日已成功落地的“再贷款+汇率避险”业务，标志着“再贷款+再贴现”双轮驱动的外贸金融支持体系初步形成，本外币合力支持外贸高质量发展的动能进一步增强。

headlines.title_en: First 'rediscount + FX hedging' transaction successfully completed in Inner Mongolia
headlines.summary_en: [Inner Mongolia's first 'rediscount + FX hedging' deal successfully landed] Per the PBOC Inner Mongolia Branch, recently, under its guidance, the region's first 'rediscount + FX hedging' deal landed in the China (Inner Mongolia) Pilot Free Trade Zone Erlianhot area. Together with the 'relending + FX hedging' deal landed on June 26, it marks the initial formation of a dual-engine foreign trade financial support system of 'relending + rediscount', further strengthening momentum for local and foreign currency synergy to support high-quality foreign trade development.

Film/TV stocks extended strength, Beijing Culture hit 2 consecutive limit-ups, Huazhi Digital Media hit 20cm limit-up. Pharmaceuticals continued active, Baihua Medicine hit 6 consecutive limit-ups, Kaikai Industrial hit 4. On the downside, commercial aerospace fell, Goldwind and China Satellite down over 6%. More stocks fell than rose, nearly 3,300 stocks declined across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing; morning turnover 1.53 trillion yuan. At midday close, Shanghai Composite down 0.05%, Shenzhen Component up 0.65%, ChiNext up 1.41%. 2. By sector/concept, MLCC, film/TV, pharma/healthcare, oil & gas led gains; commercial aerospace, minor metals, insurance, agriculture led losses. 3.
